prompt: build an advanced react demo landing page app for a saas startup using the latest and greatest best practices
endpointNote: Every harness's requests go to this one endpoint, fallbacks off, so wall time measures the harness and not OpenRouter's routing. Google Vertex served every request of the earlier Claude Haiku 5.5 suites.
effortNote: The same task as saas-landing-glm-5.3, on Claude Haiku 5.5 at reasoning effort low. Haiku takes no top_k, so none is sent. Its cached input costs a tenth of its input, so how each harness marks its prompt for caching shows in its cost (see BENCHMARK.md, Same settings as Leana).
